You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From bad9d21110037fa346426566d34dcffffc166fc6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Date: Mon, 12 Feb 2024 12:23:36 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wifi: iwlwifi: fix #ifdef CONFIG_ACPI check

The #ifdef check around the function definition for two functions was
changed without also changing the one on the declaration:

drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.c:359:6: error: redefinition of 'iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table'
  359 | void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
      |      ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
In file included from drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.c:11:
drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.h:294:6: note: previous definition of 'iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table' with type 'void(struct iwl_trans *, struct iwl_fw_runtime *)'
  294 | void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans, struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt)
      |      ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.c:392:5: error: redefinition of 'iwl_uefi_get_uats_table'
  392 | int iwl_uefi_get_uats_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
      |     ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.h:299:5: note: previous definition of 'iwl_uefi_get_uats_table' with type 'int(struct iwl_trans *, struct iwl_fw_runtime *)'
  299 | int iwl_uefi_get_uats_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
      |     ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Adapt it by merging the declarations into the existing #ifdef block.

Fixes: 74f4cd710705 ("wifi: iwlwifi: take SGOM and UATS code out of ACPI ifdef")
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Link: https://msgid.link/20240212112343.1148931-1-arnd@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.h b/drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.h
index 39053290bd59..303cc299d1bc 100644
--- a/drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.h
+++ b/drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.h
@@ -204,6 +204,9 @@ int iwl_uefi_get_mcc(struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt, char *mcc);
 int iwl_uefi_get_eckv(struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt, u32 *extl_clk);
 int iwl_uefi_get_dsm(struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt, enum iwl_dsm_funcs func,
 		     u32 *value);
+void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans, struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt);
+int iwl_uefi_get_uats_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
+			    struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt);
 #else /* CONFIG_EFI */
 static inline void *iwl_uefi_get_pnvm(struct iwl_trans *trans, size_t *len)
 {
@@ -283,13 +286,7 @@ static inline int iwl_uefi_get_dsm(struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt,
 {
 	return -ENOENT;
 }
-#endif /* CONFIG_EFI */
 
-#if defined(CONFIG_EFI) && defined(CONFIG_ACPI)
-void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans, struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt);
-int iwl_uefi_get_uats_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
-			    struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt);
-#else
 static inline
 void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans, struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt)
 {
@@ -301,5 +298,5 @@ int iwl_uefi_get_uats_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
 {
 	return 0;
 }
-#endif
+#endif /* CONFIG_EFI */
 #endif /* __iwl_fw_uefi__ */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.h`**
   - The declarations for the functions `iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table` and `iwl_uefi_get_uats_table` were moved into the existing `#ifdef CONFIG_EFI` block. 
   - The previous `#if defined(CONFIG_EFI) && defined(CONFIG_ACPI)` check was removed, and the function declarations were placed directly under the `#ifdef CONFIG_EFI` section.
   - The inline definitions of these functions were also adjusted to ensure they are only defined when `CONFIG_EFI` is not defined.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The changes in `uefi.h` address a bug related to function redefinitions caused by inconsistent preprocessor checks. By consolidating the function declarations into the `#ifdef CONFIG_EFI` block, the patch ensures that the declarations and definitions are consistently guarded by the same preprocessor condition, preventing redefinition errors.
- This modification is directly related to the previous commit referenced in the patch (`Fixes: 74f4cd710705`), which had altered the function definitions without appropriately updating the declarations, leading to the compilation errors that this patch resolves.

Code statements included in point 1 should be as brief as possible, only include the ones that are most related to the root cause and  the number of code statements may not exceed 3.


Here is the commit message:
wifi: iwlwifi: fix #ifdef CONFIG_ACPI check

The #ifdef check around the function definition for two functions was
changed without also changing the one on the declaration:

drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.c:359:6: error: redefinition of 'iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table'
  359 | void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
      |      ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
In file included from drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.c:11:
drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.h:294:6: note: previous definition of 'iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table' with type 'void(struct iwl_trans *, struct iwl_fw_runtime *)'
  294 | void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans, struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt)
      |      ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.c:392:5: error: redefinition of 'iwl_uefi_get_uats_table'
  392 | int iwl_uefi_get_uats_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
      |     ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
drivers/net/wireless/intel/iwlwifi/fw/uefi.h:299:5: note: previous definition of 'iwl_uefi_get_uats_table' with type 'int(struct iwl_trans *, struct iwl_fw_runtime *)'
  299 | int iwl_uefi_get_uats_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
      |     ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Adapt it by merging the declarations into the existing #ifdef block.

Fixes: 74f4cd710705 ("wifi: iwlwifi: take SGOM and UATS code out of ACPI ifdef")
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Link: https://msgid.link/20240212112343.1148931-1-arnd@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by inconsistent preprocessor checks around the function declarations and definitions for `iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table` and `iwl_uefi_get_uats_table`. The function definitions were moved out of the `#ifdef CONFIG_ACPI` block in a previous commit, but the corresponding declarations in the header file were not updated, leading to redefinition errors during compilation.

Here is the patch:
 int iwl_uefi_get_dsm(struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt, enum iwl_dsm_funcs func,
 		     u32 *value);
+void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans, struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt);
+int iwl_uefi_get_uats_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
+			    struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt);
 #else /* CONFIG_EFI */
 static inline void *iwl_uefi_get_pnvm(struct iwl_trans *trans, size_t *len)
 	return -ENOENT;
 }
-#endif /* CONFIG_EFI */
 
-#if defined(CONFIG_EFI) && defined(CONFIG_ACPI)
-void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans, struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt);
-int iwl_uefi_get_uats_table(struct iwl_trans *trans,
-			    struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt);
-#else
 static inline
 void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans, struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt)
 	return 0;
 }
-#endif
+#endif /* CONFIG_EFI */
 #endif /* __iwl_fw_uefi__ */
--

Reason:
The function declarations for `iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table` and `iwl_uefi_get_uats_table` were not enclosed within the `#ifdef CONFIG_ACPI` block after the function definitions were moved outside of it. This inconsistency led to redefinition errors during compilation, as the compiler found multiple definitions of the same functions.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+void iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table(struct iwl_trans *trans, struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt);
+int iwl_uefi_get_uats_table(struct iwl_trans *trans, struct iwl_fw_runtime *fwrt);
```
Reason:
By moving the declarations of `iwl_uefi_get_sgom_table` and `iwl_uefi_get_uats_table` into the `#ifdef CONFIG_ACPI` block, the patch ensures that both the declarations and definitions are consistently checked against the same preprocessor condition. This prevents redefinition errors during compilation, as the functions are now only defined and declared when `CONFIG_ACPI` is enabled.
